body: Tanushree Bagrodia (Director & Group CEO) on the Q1FY27 call (2026-08-05), prompted: "over the next 12 months, we do expect this to normalize" Metric: Aftermarket revenue YoY. Target: Return to growth by ~Aug-2027. Deadline: 2027-08-31 (vague). Specificity: vague. Status as of 2026-11-19: DELIVERED. Evidence: Q2FY27 (2026-11-05): aftermarket 16.5% of revenue vs 14.7% in Q2FY26; 'In absolute terms, the segment grew over 50% year-on-year'. One quarter; management warns it varies quarter to quarter. Single-source.
